summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, updating its vessel acquisition schedule under its omnibus agreement with sponsor Knutsen NYK. The Conflicts Committee declined to pursue shuttle tankers Frida Knutsen and Sindre Knutsen due to insufficient charters, while negotiations continue for Hedda Knutsen. No terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The update is a routine report on potential related-party acquisitions, not a definitive deal. No advisor or recommendation was mentioned. Watch for future definitive agreements or charter developments.
